description: Main source file for an AWS IoT MQTT client application using Zephyr RTOS, handling MQTT communication, TLS credentials, SNTP time sync, and network resolution.

methods.name: setup_credentials
methods.description: Configures TLS credentials for device certificate, private key, and CA certificate.

methods.name: subscribe_topic
methods.description: Subscribes to a specified MQTT topic.

methods.name: publish_message
methods.description: Publishes a message to a specified MQTT topic.

methods.name: handle_published_message
methods.description: Handles incoming MQTT published messages, including payload processing and ACK.

methods.name: mqtt_evt_type_to_str
methods.description: Converts MQTT event type enum to string.

methods.name: mqtt_event_cb
methods.description: MQTT event callback handling connection, publish, subscribe, and other events.

methods.name: aws_client_setup
methods.description: Initializes MQTT client with TLS and connection parameters.

methods.name: backoff_context_init
methods.description: Initializes backoff context for connection retries.

methods.name: backoff_get_next
methods.description: Calculates next backoff delay with optional exponential backoff.

methods.name: aws_client_try_connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to MQTT broker with retries and backoff.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Prepares and publishes a JSON payload with message counter.

methods.name: aws_client_loop
methods.description: Main loop handling MQTT connection, message processing, and network events.

methods.name: sntp_sync_time
methods.description: Synchronizes system time with SNTP server.

methods.name: resolve_broker_addr
methods.description: Resolves MQTT broker hostname to IP address.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point initializing network, time sync, credentials, and running MQTT client loop.
